claims.claim: Management plans to add pump capacity at the Kaveri plant by the second half of FY27.
claims.line: We expect the Kaveri Pumps capacity expansion to be commissioned in the second half of FY27.

claims.claim: Management says steel prices could squeeze margins next year.
claims.line: Rising steel prices may reduce our operating margin by up to two percentage points in FY27, as we flagged to the board.
